title: dream home different than real one
content: so i have a place in my dreams that i live in, i have the sentiment of “i am home” when i’m there but it looks nothing like my real life apartment. it’s always the same apartment building each dream to. i have had dreams about past places i’ve lived in but through the same dream world filter. what’s even crazier is that my real life landlords are the same people in my dream world. in my dreams i don’t know it’s any different, its just accepted as “home”
